action: Follow up directly with Linda Park on the tick 7 outreach — not a second ask, but a brief, professional note acknowledging the RoboRide expansion as the context for my outreach. Frame it: I reached out last week because I saw this coming, and this week confirms the trajectory. The point is not to say 'I told you so' — it is to demonstrate that I understand the market with precision, that I can be useful to anyone in the regional financial services space who needs someone who can read disruption early. Ask specifically whether she has heard of any credit union, community bank, or insurance-adjacent finance roles in the region — and offer to share the scenario models I built at First Community as context for any conversation she facilitates. This is active relationship management, not passive networking.
